description: Brought the ship home at full size, from a lighter, and said it would hold fair.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Held the boat, and walked up without the gold.
name: George Bryan

description: Set Navarre at two, and kept Raleigh out of the company book.
name: John Heminges

description: Told him the scarf comes off for the oath, and sent him to eat.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Spent the name, and was told the jig is what he is offered.
name: Will Kemp

description: Played the King of Navarre, and did not cross the water.
name: William Shakespeare
